meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: Claude 会新增两个工具：列出本机 Atomic Chat 中可用的模型，以及把提示发给指定模型并取回回答。模型由 Atomic Chat 桌面应用提供，Claude 仍是调度方。
howto.when: 当你要求用 Atomic Chat 的本地模型回答问题，或在对话里提到 Atomic Chat 时触发；它会先列出可用模型，再调用指定模型生成回答。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都是哪里
say.note: 会先列出模型，再生成回答

say.text: 列出 Atomic Chat 里当前可用的模型
用 atomic chat 的 qwen 模型写一段排序代码

howto.what_en: Claude gains two tools: list the models available in the local Atomic Chat app, and send a prompt to a chosen model and return its reply. Models are served by the Atomic Chat desktop app; Claude stays the orchestrator.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to answer using Atomic Chat's local models, or mention Atomic Chat; it lists models first, then generates.

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Lists models, then generates an answer

say_en.text: List the models currently available in Atomic Chat
Use atomic chat's qwen model to write a sorting function
